pre_production.description: Local, model, and sandbox-verifiable checks required before deployment. For provider and lifecycle gates, this phase validates local adapter contracts, authorization boundaries, fail-closed behavior, and sandbox-safe paths only; it does not claim live production connectivity. For GATE-11, GATE-12, and GATE-14, only the local contract/sandbox-safe portions are pre-production; their live production portions are listed separately below.

stage_45.name: Final Pre-Production Production-Readiness Verification
stage_45.purpose: Evaluate all 44 pre-production checks and authorize deployment only when every check passes with current, commit-matched evidence.
pass_conditions: Exactly 44 unique pre-production checks are present.
All 44 checks have PASSED status at LOCAL, MODEL, or SANDBOX scope appropriate to the check.
Evidence is current, commit-matched, hash-verified, and reproducible.
Release artifact and deployment target are identified and validated.
No unresolved pre-production integrity, security, or policy blocker remains.
must_not_depend_on: Post-deployment monitoring or whole-product production exercise

post_production.description: Checks that require a deployed production or approved production-like target. These checks run after Stage 45 authorizes deployment and are recorded as a separate operational evidence set; they are not a numbered stage.

checks.name: Live Neon and PayPal provider connectivity/authentication
Production truth-boundary audit and live readiness evidence
Central Failure Diversion Preserves Evidence & Executes Rollback
Deployment health, readiness, telemetry, cgroup memory enforcement, and monitoring
Failure diversion, rollback, and recovery exercise
Integrated SolveX verification including Daisy 54-node graph, node handoffs, JIT generation, packaging, distribution, and recovery

rules: Never promote EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_REQUIRED, PENDING, or BLOCKED to PASSED.
Local, model, and sandbox evidence cannot establish production connectivity.
Stage 45 consumes only the 44 pre-production results.
No post-production result may be a prerequisite of Stage 45.
Post-production checks execute only after deployment and are not part of the 45-stage pre-production sequence.
